from PIL import Image
import numpy as np
im=np.array(Image.open('first_frame.png').convert('RGB'))
# 64x36 label map based on dominant characteristics, blocks 4x4
H,W=im.shape[:2]
chars=np.full((36,64),' ')
for j in range(36):
 for i in range(64):
  b=im[j*4:(j+1)*4,i*4:(i+1)*4].reshape(-1,3).mean(0)
  r,g,bv=b
  if r>210 and g>210 and bv>200: c='W'
  elif r>140 and r>g*1.35 and g>bv*1.15: c='O'
  elif max(b)-min(b)<18:
   c='.' if np.mean(b)<50 else (':' if np.mean(b)<110 else ('-' if np.mean(b)<170 else 'L'))
  elif bv>r and bv>g: c='B'
  elif g>r and g>bv: c='G'
  elif r>g and r>bv: c='r'
  else: c='x'
  chars[j,i]=c
print('\\n'.join(''.join(row) for row in chars))
# row / col counts for white and orange thresholds
white=(im[:,:,0]>210)&(im[:,:,1]>210)&(im[:,:,2]>200)
orange=(im[:,:,0]>140)&(im[:,:,0]>im[:,:,1]*1.3)&(im[:,:,1]>im[:,:,2]*1.1)
print('white rows', [(y,int(white[y].sum())) for y in range(H) if white[y].sum()>5])
print('orange rows', [(y,int(orange[y].sum())) for y in range(H) if orange[y].sum()>0])
print('white cols range chunks', [(x,int(white[:,x].sum())) for x in range(0,W,8)])
print('orange cols chunks', [(x,int(orange[:,x].sum())) for x in range(0,W,8)])
PY"
